$comment: The files of this repository that are the work of others: where each one comes from, on what terms it is redistributed and whether it is unchanged. NOTICE gives their notices, docs/third-party-licenses.md is generated from this file (make licenses), and make security fails when a file that looks like the work of a third party is not listed here, when a listed file is missing, when an unchanged file no longer has its SHA-256, or when a file loses the notice its group keeps (scripts/security/notices.mjs).

groups.name: OASIS Universal Business Language (UBL) 2.1 schemas
groups.origin: UBL 2.1 OS (4 November 2013), as the DIAN toolbox v1.9 (Caja de herramientas FE - V1.9 - (v2026-2)) ships it. 11 of these files are byte for byte those of the OASIS distribution (docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/UBL-2.1.zip). The credit note, debit note and AttachedDocument schemas are of the CS1 edition (16 June 2013): their definitions equal the OS edition, and only the comments that name the edition differ.
groups.terms: The OASIS copyright notice: copies may be made and distributed as long as the notice stays on them and the schemas are not modified. NOTICE reproduces the notice.

groups.name: XML Signature schema, in its UBL 2.1 copy
groups.origin: The W3C schema xmldsig-core-schema.xsd, which OASIS copied into UBL 2.1 OS with the PUBLIC and SYSTEM identifiers of its DOCTYPE removed, as the file says; the DIAN toolbox v1.9 ships that copy, byte for byte the one of the OASIS distribution.
groups.terms: The W3C Software License that the file names (http://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/copyright-software-19980720): redistribution is allowed with the notice the file keeps.
groups.notice: Copyright 2001 The Internet Society and W3C

groups.name: XAdES schemas, in their UBL 2.1 copies
groups.origin: The ETSI schemas of XAdES 1.3.2 and 1.4.1 (uri.etsi.org/01903), which OASIS copied into UBL 2.1 OS changing only the URI they import XML Signature from, as each file says; the DIAN toolbox v1.9 ships those copies, byte for byte the ones of the OASIS distribution.
groups.terms: Redistributed as OASIS distributes them in UBL 2.1, with the comment that names their ETSI origin.
groups.notice: This is a copy of http://uri.etsi.org/01903/

groups.name: UN/CEFACT Core Component Type schema module
groups.origin: The CCTS schema module of UBL 2.1 OS, as the DIAN toolbox v1.9 ships it, byte for byte the one of the OASIS distribution.
groups.terms: The UN/CEFACT notice in the file: it may be copied and distributed with the notice, and may not be modified.

groups.name: Schema of the DIAN extensions of UBL 2.1
groups.owner: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales de Colombia)
groups.origin: XSD/maindoc/DIAN_UBL_Structures.xsd of the DIAN toolbox v1.9 (Caja de herramientas FE - V1.9 - (v2026-2)), published with the technical annex of the electronic sales invoice, version 1.9, which Resolución 000165 of 1 November 2023 adopts.
groups.terms: Part of the annex of an administrative act: article 41 of Ley 23 de 1982 lets anyone reproduce administrative acts as long as the copy conforms to the official edition. It is kept byte for byte as the toolbox ships it.

groups.name: Inter 4.1 fonts
groups.origin: extras/ttf/Inter-Regular.ttf, Inter-Medium.ttf and Inter-SemiBold.ttf and LICENSE.txt of the Inter 4.1 release (zip SHA-256 9883fdd4a49d4fb66bd8177ba6625ef9a64aa45899767dde3d36aa425756b11e), byte for byte. The PDF renderer embeds copies whose digits map to the tabular figures of the same font (backend/app/Modules/Delivery/Pdf/TabularFigures.php); those copies exist only in memory and in the PDFs.
groups.terms: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE.txt next to the fonts): the fonts may be bundled and redistributed with software; the license covers the fonts, not the documents made with them.

groups.name: DANE DIVIPOLA municipality codes
groups.origin: The 1,122 records of the dataset "DIVIPOLA- Códigos municipios" (gdxc-w37w) of datos.gov.co, updated by DANE on 2025-01-24 and downloaded on 2026-11-18. The records are as the portal serves them (identical to its data on 2026-11-22); the file adds the source, the dates and the count around them.
groups.terms: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International, the license the portal gives the dataset: attribution to DANE, and the file and its adaptations stay under the same license.
groups.notice: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística - DANE

groups.name: shadcn-vue components
groups.origin: The interface components of shadcn-vue (style reka-vega, frontend/components.json), copied into the web app by its CLI, then formatted with the project's Prettier configuration and adapted in places.
groups.terms: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 unovue; NOTICE reproduces it.

excerpts.name: Code lists, rules, messages and examples of the DIAN technical annex 1.9
excerpts.what: The codes and official names of section 13's tables, the codes and messages of the validation rules in sections 8 and 12 (in Spanish, as the annex writes them), and the values of the CUFE and CUDE examples in section 11, inside this project's files.
excerpts.terms: Part of the annex that Resolución 000165 of 2023 adopts, reproduced as published (article 41 of Ley 23 de 1982).

removed.what: "Ejemplificación Impuesto especial para la estabilidad fiscal.xml", an example invoice of the DIAN toolbox v1.9.
removed.why: Support material that nothing in the repository reads; make dian-toolbox downloads the whole toolbox, with its SHA-256, when a check needs it.

outside.name: The DIAN toolbox v1.9 (schematron, code lists, examples, the annex)
outside.how: make dian-toolbox downloads it from the DIAN into backend/storage/app/dian-toolbox, never committed, and checks its SHA-256; only make dian-schematron needs it.

outside.name: The DIAN signature policy (politicadefirmav2.pdf)
outside.how: Never downloaded: each signature names its URL and the SHA-256 digest of the official examples (backend/app/Modules/Dian/Signing/XadesSigner.php).

outside.name: The certificate authorities of Amazon RDS (global-bundle.pem)
outside.how: Downloaded into the image of the functions when it is built, pinned by its SHA-256 (backend/Dockerfile).

outside.name: Stoplight Elements 8.4.2
outside.how: Loaded by the browser from unpkg.com for the API reference, pinned by Subresource Integrity (backend/resources/http/security-headers.json).

outside.name: SaxonJS 2.7.0 and SchXslt 1.10.1
outside.how: Downloaded by make dian-schematron into a Docker volume (scripts/dian-schematron/run.sh).
